description: This Java source file defines the class MongoTimestampPersistence, which implements TimestampPersistence interface. It handles storing, retrieving, and managing timestamps in a MongoDB collection, with functionalities including setting timestamps with optional tags, retrieving the latest timestamp, and ensuring the collection exists as a capped collection. It leverages reactive streams with Akka and MongoDB reactive streams driver, including restart and broadcast sources for resilient and shared access.

classes.name: MongoTimestampPersistence
classes.description: A final class implementing TimestampPersistence, managing timestamp storage in MongoDB via reactive streams with resilience and batch management.

methods.name: initializedInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an initialized MongoTimestampPersistence instance with a capped collection, setting up the reactive stream source.

methods.name: setTimestamp
methods.description: Stores a timestamp without a tag into the MongoDB collection, returning a Source indicating completion.

methods.name: setTaggedTimestamp
methods.description: Stores a timestamp with an optional tag into the collection, returning a Source signaling success.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Retrieves the MongoCollection wrapped in a Source, with an unchecked cast due to streaming API constraints.

methods.name: getTimestampAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent timestamp asynchronously, as an Optional<Instant>.

methods.name: getTaggedTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent tagged timestamp as an Optional< Pair<Instant, String> >.

methods.name: createOrGetCappedCollection
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a capped MongoDB collection as a source stream, with restart/backoff semantics.

methods.name: repeatableCreateCappedCollectionSource
methods.description: Creates a capped collection in MongoDB, with error recovery if the collection already exists.

methods.name: isCollectionAlreadyExistsError
methods.description: Checks if a MongoCommandException corresponds to a collection already existing error.
